questions.prompt: What does a map show?
options: A drawing of places on the earth
questions.correctAnswer: A drawing of places on the earth
questions.explanation: A map is a drawing that shows places and features on the earth's surface.
questions.learningOutcome: Identify the meaning and purpose of a simple map.

questions.prompt: Which part of a map tells what the map is about?
questions.correctAnswer: Title
questions.explanation: The title names the area or topic shown on a map.
questions.learningOutcome: Recognize the main parts of a simple map.

questions.prompt: Which map feature explains symbols used on a map?
questions.correctAnswer: Key
questions.explanation: A map key explains what each symbol on the map represents.
questions.learningOutcome: Identify the use of a key on a simple map.

questions.learningOutcome: Use cardinal directions to describe position.

questions.prompt: On a simple map, a blue line most often shows which feature?
questions.correctAnswer: River
questions.explanation: Blue is commonly used to show water features such as rivers, lakes and oceans.
questions.learningOutcome: Interpret common symbols and colours on simple maps.

questions.prompt: Why do maps use symbols instead of drawing every object as it looks?
options: Symbols save space and are easy to read
Symbols make maps impossible to use
Symbols are only used for decoration
questions.correctAnswer: Symbols save space and are easy to read
questions.explanation: Symbols help many features fit on a small map in a clear way.
questions.learningOutcome: Explain why symbols are useful on maps.

questions.prompt: Which item helps a learner know direction when drawing a sketch map?
questions.correctAnswer: Compass rose
questions.explanation: A compass rose shows directions such as north, south, east and west.
questions.learningOutcome: Use direction signs when drawing a simple sketch map.

questions.prompt: The school gate is east of the classroom. Which direction should a learner walk from the classroom to reach the gate?

questions.prompt: A sketch map of a village should include the market, school and river. What should be added to explain these features?

questions.prompt: Which pair shows natural features that may appear on a map?
